title: Ordinary restriction-pullback composition
statement: For the coefficient map in [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface] and integral-to-residue scalar restriction, for composable scheme maps f,g, the ordinary upperStarComp followed by the two inverse comapUpperStarIso comparisons equals the inverse comparison for fg followed by restriction of the residue upperStarComp. This is the displayed equation in the Lean declaration, for every ordinary residue module on the last scheme.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Specialize [new-comap-upper-star-iso-composition] to integralReductionMap ℓ E. Postcompose the displayed goal with the forward comparison for f, then the pullback of the forward comparison for g. The inverse/forward identities cancel, reducing the target to the proved general coefficient-map composition equation.

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidue_ordinaryRestrictPull_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) Z)) :
    (upperStarComp (integralCoeff ℓ E) f g).hom.app
        ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Z)).obj N) ≫
      (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.map
        ((comapUpperStarIso (integralReductionMap ℓ E) g).inv.app N) ≫
      (comapUpperStarIso (integralReductionMap ℓ E) f).inv.app
        ((g)^*⟦Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)⟧.obj N) =
    (comapUpperStarIso (integralReductionMap ℓ E) (f ≫ g)).inv.app N ≫
      (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) X)).map
        ((upperStarComp
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f g).hom.app N)
